summary: Iter11 PRIMARY BUG (compass overlap/overflow) FULLY FIXED and NEW FEATURE (theme picker) works. Measured on 390x844 viewport with location granted: compass-rose = 220x220, borderRadius=110px, overflow=hidden. Layout: auto-detect-badge.bottom=135 < compass-rose.top=163 (28px gap) AND compass-rose.bottom=383 < metric-altitude.top=403 (20px gap) — no overlap. Center readout (000°, N, MAG) — every text node returns inside:true against the compass bounding box. Visual: dark ring with orange-tinted border rendered as expected (screenshot /tmp/step2_inflight.png). Settings > APPEARANCE renders segmented control testID='theme-mode' with all 3 options (dark/light/auto) — taps switch selection with visual highlight (screenshot /tmp/step4_theme_light.png). Backend theme_mode: GET/PUT /api/prefs accept and echo theme_mode; all 4 theme_mode pytests pass; persistence across GET verified for light/auto/dark. Regressions: login, dashboard weather (VFR/CLR/22°C), WindRose, runway wind, hourly strip, tab navigation, logbook fetch all still work.
action_items: No action required. Primary compass overlap bug and theme picker feature both verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: CompassRose.tsx:23 correctly applies overflow:'hidden' + borderRadius:size/2 to the outer container.
CompassRose.tsx:143-148 absolute-positioned center readout (top/left/right/bottom:0 + center alignment) keeps 000°/direction/MAG perfectly centered inside the ring.
CompassRose.tsx:118 ring uses backgroundColor:'#0A0C0E' with borderColor: colors.brand+'55' (orange-tinted) and elevation:8 shadow — matches spec.
backend/server.py:118 Prefs.theme_mode: str='dark' default; GET returns and PUT persists correctly. Uses Pydantic default so legacy prefs docs missing the field will coerce to 'dark'.
settings.tsx:137-155 APPEARANCE section: SegRow with testID='theme-mode' generates testID='theme-mode-{key}' per option — good for automation. Info note about light-theme rollout is present.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 theme_mode tests + login + logbook + me pass; 2 unrelated regression tests failed only because my test used wrong endpoint paths)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo@test.com / demopass123 user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compass-rose at viewport 390x844 measured 220x220 with borderRadius:110px overflow:hidden. auto-detect-badge y=[111,135], compass y=[163,383], metric-altitude y=[403,480] — clear 28px & 20px vertical gaps confirm no overlap. All center-readout text nodes (000°, N, MAG) are geometrically inside the compass bounding box. Theme picker segmented control testID='theme-mode' works with individual option testIDs 'theme-mode-dark', 'theme-mode-light', 'theme-mode-auto'. Backend PUT/GET /api/prefs correctly echo theme_mode field.
rca_of_issue: N/A — bug already fixed by main agent. Verified fix root cause: adding overflow:'hidden'+borderRadius:size/2 to the outer compass View clips the internal absolute-positioned dial/ticks so they cannot leak into the vertical siblings, and switching the center readout to absolute inset:0 with center alignment keeps it geometrically inside the circle regardless of parent layout.
